title: Reverse publish abort: another device already cancelled the task

preconditions.comment: Controller has two devices online; publish flow MUST observe-then-write.

input_steps.operation: begin reverse publish (read task state, prepare source Message)
abort publish; do NOT emit source Message

design_note: Reverse publish is observe-then-write at the client: re-read task state immediately before emitting; abort if terminal. Reducer alone cannot prevent stale publish because the source Message is in a different Realm — client cooperation is required.
